calibration_flags.ok: Slice closer at or above the threshold. Cards may lead only when the rest of the tier rule holds.
calibration_flags.soft: FLAG — calibration soft. Do not lead the pack. Show FLAG on the card.

coin.rule: HX win probability within 5pp of 50 (45–55% toss-up)

A.rule: Top 25 slice, calibration ok (closer ≥ 50%), large |HX−Vegas| (≥ 4 pts), strong lean (≥ 15pp from 50). Winner flips allowed. Can lead the pack. Never a lock.

B.rule: Top 25 slice, calibration ok, small |HX−Vegas| (< 4 pts), strong lean. Same favorite as the book. Do not lead.

C.rule: Top 25 slice, calibration ok, coin lean (45–55% toss-up). Small-edge character. Do not lead.

D.rule: Full-slate slice under the 45% closer FLAG, or any card whose slice is calibration-soft. Do not lead. Soft cards show FLAG — calibration soft. Never a lock.

free.includes: Public schedule HX vs Vegas only — spread gap, same favorite called out. One Make 12 cell on the board. No ranked confidence cards.

paid.includes: Ranked confidence cards A–D with calibration FLAGS, unit O/D pulse, tape write-up. Same HX as the public board — written out. Not a second rating.
